==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Militarev and Kogan reconstruct {{m|sem-pro||*kabid(-at)-}}, with various vowel patterns among the descendants: {{m|sem-pro||*kabid-}} (Akkadian, Hebrew, Ugaritic, Arabic), {{m|sem-pro||*kabd-}} (Akkadian, Aramaic, Arabic, Ethiopian Semitic) and {{m|sem-pro||*kibd-}} (Arabic, probably Modern South Arabian). A more general sense “entrails” can be reconstructed alongside “liver”, on the evidence of Akkadian, Ugaritic, Mandaic and Arabic; Ethiopian Semitic has “belly”. A derivation from {{m|sem-pro||*kbd}} “to be heavy” is typologically tenable.<ref>{{R:sem-pro:SED|volume=I|id=33|entry=*kabid(-at)-}}</ref>
